gloss: food waste; raw garbage; kitchen waste

definitions.gloss: food waste; raw garbage; kitchen waste
definitions.explanation: organic waste from food preparation and leftovers that can decompose and smell

examples.japanese: {生|なま}ゴミ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I take out the food waste every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生|なま}ゴミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{臭|にお}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: In summer, the smell of food waste is terrible.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}ゴミ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: Drain the moisture from food waste before throwing it away.

notes:
FORMS:
- ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw, fresh)
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ (garbage, waste)

DISPOSAL:
In most Japanese municipalities, {生|なま}ゴミ is classified as ⟦{可燃|かねん}→可燃：26077_kanen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ (burnable garbage).

TIPS:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (drain water to reduce smell and weight)
- ⟦{新聞紙|しんぶんし}→新聞紙：20415_shinbunshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (wrap in newspaper)
